# alphamine: block placeholders (generated by tools/alphamine/gen_pack_blocks.py)

Blocks whose Alpha render type VoxelCore cannot draw 1:1 yet. Standard cubes (texel inset, light, fog in
shaders/), renderCrossedSquares (models/amblk_cross.vcm: saplings, flowers, mushrooms, reeds), meta texture
variants and the RenderBlocks geometry of torches, ladders, rails, stairs, doors, levers, buttons, cactus and
crops (models/amblk_<block>_m<meta>.vcm, one per state variant, textures baked in) are exact in the flat
layer (devworld, agents/ALPHAMINE.md 10: 97-100 % per exhibit). Lit layer: the pack shader multiplies
axis-aligned planes by the face factor 0.6/0.8 -- Alpha draws torches, ladders, crops unshaded (and blocks with
lightValue > 0 at brightness 1.0); that is shaders/main.glslf, not these files.

Runtime limits (VoxelCore 0.31 = 454aa205): ModelsGenerator::prepare resolves "$i" textures only for the
default variant (state variants must name atlas textures); ContentGfxCache::refresh skips the last variant
(index 15): meta 15 of a state-based block has no UVs/model (custom models: drawn as 'none').

- 8 `water_moving`: water: engine cube, Alpha look done in shaders (translucent.glsl*: corner heights, flow direction, animated TextureWaterFX/FlowFX from modules/texfx.lua, fluid light); open: non-planar tops use the engine's other triangle diagonal, tops under a solid block are culled by the engine (Alpha draws them)
- 8 `water_moving`: light opacity 3: engine light has no partial opacity -- rendering uses the server's light (modules/lightmap.lua); blocks changed after the MapChunk are not relit (Alpha's client relights)
- 9 `water_still`: water: engine cube, Alpha look done in shaders (translucent.glsl*: corner heights, flow direction, animated TextureWaterFX/FlowFX from modules/texfx.lua, fluid light); open: non-planar tops use the engine's other triangle diagonal, tops under a solid block are culled by the engine (Alpha draws them)
- 9 `water_still`: light opacity 3: engine light has no partial opacity -- rendering uses the server's light (modules/lightmap.lua); blocks changed after the MapChunk are not relit (Alpha's client relights)
- 10 `lava_moving`: lava: plain full block with the static tile; TextureLavaFX/LavaFlowFX are simulated (modules/texfx.lua, am_fx) but main.glslf does not apply them or the fluid heights yet
- 11 `lava_still`: lava: plain full block with the static tile; TextureLavaFX/LavaFlowFX are simulated (modules/texfx.lua, am_fx) but main.glslf does not apply them or the fluid heights yet
- 18 `leaves`: light opacity 1: engine light has no partial opacity -- rendering uses the server's light (modules/lightmap.lua); blocks changed after the MapChunk are not relit (Alpha's client relights)
- 50 `torch`: torch: geometry exact (renderTorchAtAngle per meta); Alpha draws blocks with lightValue > 0 at brightness 1.0, the pack shader uses the cell light (lit layer: shaders, not blocks)
- 51 `fire`: fire: renderBlockFire (slanted planes + animated TextureFlamesFX) -> X placeholder, static tile
- 55 `redstone_wire`: redstone wire: flat aabb placeholder; Alpha picks tile by connections, colour by power
- 63 `sign_standing`: sign: aabb placeholder; Alpha TileEntitySignRenderer (model + text)
- 64 `door_wood`: door: geometry exact (3/16 panel by getState, mirrored tiles by meta); faces against solid blocks are culled by the engine (Alpha draws all six)
- 64 `door_wood`: door meta 15 (top half, open, state 3) is not drawn: the runtime never prepares state variant 15 (ContentGfxCache::refresh off-by-one)
- 68 `sign_wall`: sign: aabb placeholder; Alpha TileEntitySignRenderer (model + text)
- 71 `door_steel`: door: geometry exact (3/16 panel by getState, mirrored tiles by meta); faces against solid blocks are culled by the engine (Alpha draws all six)
- 71 `door_steel`: door meta 15 (top half, open, state 3) is not drawn: the runtime never prepares state variant 15 (ContentGfxCache::refresh off-by-one)
- 75 `torch_redstone_idle`: torch: geometry exact (renderTorchAtAngle per meta); Alpha draws blocks with lightValue > 0 at brightness 1.0, the pack shader uses the cell light (lit layer: shaders, not blocks)
- 76 `torch_redstone_active`: torch: geometry exact (renderTorchAtAngle per meta); Alpha draws blocks with lightValue > 0 at brightness 1.0, the pack shader uses the cell light (lit layer: shaders, not blocks)
- 79 `ice`: light opacity 3: engine light has no partial opacity -- rendering uses the server's light (modules/lightmap.lua); blocks changed after the MapChunk are not relit (Alpha's client relights)
